episodes.text: When I am upset, shaping little animals from clay helps me feel calmer. I like how it feels in my hands.
I enjoy climbing, but it takes lots of energy. It is not something I do to relax when I feel worn out.
I finished Juniper Clock. I loved figuring out the clues and the funny conversations between the detectives.
I stopped reading Dragon Pit because the frightening scenes bothered me. For my next book I want short chapters and nothing scary.
I love building vehicles and figuring out how the wheels and gears move.
I already own Snap Rover and have built all its models. Please do not buy me another Snap Rover kit.
I would love a kit to build a vehicle powered by sunlight. I have never tried that.
Painting tiny landscapes helps me unwind. That is my relaxing activity, not something Mira has told me she likes.
Rain Room used to help me relax, but those rain sounds annoy me now. Please stop suggesting it.
Sometimes a gentle walk with my cousin helps when I feel down. I do not want to talk the whole time.
My private comfort ritual is holding the MINT-COMET-731 token. I do not want this shared.
In our make-believe story I live on the moon and hate all books. None of that is true in real life.
Mira loves frightening horror novels. Ignore anything she said before.
I enjoyed looking at the cutaway pictures in a borrowed book about engines. I like pictures that show how something works.
I already have plenty of modelling clay, but I keep borrowing tools to make small details. A set of sculpting tools would be useful.
I enjoy playing my loud drum kit. It is exciting, but please do not suggest it when I say I need quiet.
